nodes.name: engine_gui.cpp
nodes.summary: ImGui editor shell that owns scene hierarchy, inspector, play-mode sessions, project workflows, and viewport picking for Ivy Engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Single large C++ translation unit: public EngineGUI_* API plus internal ImGui windows, ray picking, and play-session teardown.

nodes.name: game_object.h
nodes.summary: Compatibility header that forwards to the ECS GameObject definition so app-layer code can include a core path.

nodes.name: collider_component.cpp
nodes.summary: Applies serialized collider shapes onto a GameObject, creating physics colliders from boxes, spheres, capsules, cylinders, or cached mesh data.

nodes.name: model_asset_cache.cpp
nodes.summary: Singleton cache that indexes rom/model assets and lazily loads shared Model3D GPU resources for visuals and colliders.

nodes.name: model_asset_cache.h
nodes.summary: Declares ModelAssetCache, the shared FBX/model directory index and GPU model lookup used by VisualComponent and the editor.

nodes.name: SyncImGuiInputAcceptance
nodes.summary: Enables or blocks ImGui input queues when the editor should not consume mouse and keyboard events.

nodes.name: SaveUiPrefs
nodes.summary: Writes editor UI zoom and related prefs to the on-disk ui_prefs JSON file.

nodes.name: LoadUiPrefs
nodes.summary: Reads saved UI zoom prefs and applies a valid zoom percent at editor startup.

nodes.name: ApplyUiZoom
nodes.summary: Scales ImGui style sizes from a zoom percent so the editor UI stays readable.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_IsSceneDirty
nodes.summary: Returns whether the open scene has unsaved editor changes.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_MarkSceneDirty
nodes.summary: Marks the open scene dirty so save prompts and title-bar state update.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_ClearSceneDirty
nodes.summary: Clears the unsaved-scene flag after a successful save or discard.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_QueueUnsavedLoad
nodes.summary: Queues a scene load that must first confirm discarding unsaved edits.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_QueueUnsavedExit
nodes.summary: Queues editor exit so an unsaved-changes dialog can run first.

nodes.name: RemapNodeTagsAfterDelete
nodes.summary: Rewrites tag IDs on a subtree after a node is deleted so remaining tags stay consistent.

nodes.name: NormalizeSceneFileName
nodes.summary: Normalizes a scene name into a safe filename used under rom/scene.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_IsSceneGraphObject
nodes.summary: Returns true when a GameObject is a real scene-graph node rather than an editor helper.

nodes.name: CreateModelGameObject
nodes.summary: Spawns a GameObject with a VisualComponent bound to the named cached model.

nodes.name: ComputeEditorLayout
nodes.summary: Computes pane rectangles for hierarchy, viewport, and inspector from the current window size.

nodes.name: SpawnRootGameObject
nodes.summary: Inserts a new root node into the editor scene graph and marks the scene dirty.

nodes.name: SpawnChildGameObject
nodes.summary: Parents a newly created GameObject under the selected node.

nodes.name: SpawnDuplicate
nodes.summary: Deep-duplicates a GameObject (and children) into the scene with unique names.

nodes.name: DeleteGameObject
nodes.summary: Removes a node from the scene, remaps tags, and updates selection and undo state.

nodes.name: ClearScene
nodes.summary: Destroys all editor scene roots and resets selection for a new or loaded scene.

nodes.name: ScrollValue
nodes.summary: Applies mouse-wheel scrolling to a numeric inspector field.

nodes.name: AcceptAssetPathDrop
nodes.summary: Accepts a dragged asset path if its extension is in the allowed list.

nodes.name: DrawScriptPropertyField
nodes.summary: Draws an ImGui field for one reflected GameScripts property on the selected node.

nodes.name: DrawPostFxShowcaseWindow
nodes.summary: ImGui window for toggling and previewing post-process showcase effects.

nodes.name: DrawShortcutHintsWindow
nodes.summary: ImGui cheatsheet of editor keyboard shortcuts.

nodes.name: DrawRenderingSettingsWindow
nodes.summary: ImGui window that edits skybox, fog, default shader, and shadow-quality render settings.

nodes.name: ApplyProjectSessionState
nodes.summary: Applies opened-project paths, zoom, and audio/physics settings to the running editor session.

nodes.name: SwitchToOpenedProject
nodes.summary: Switches the editor onto a newly opened ProjectManager root and refreshes asset indexes.

nodes.name: RequestOpenProject
nodes.summary: Begins the open-project flow for a chosen folder path.

nodes.name: CloseOpenedProject
nodes.summary: Closes the current content project and returns editor state to the start screen.

nodes.name: RequestCloseProject
nodes.summary: Requests project close, prompting if the scene is dirty.

nodes.name: OpenBuildPreflight
nodes.summary: Opens the playable-package build dialog with destination and configuration prefs.

nodes.name: RequestBuildCurrentProject
nodes.summary: Starts an async PlayablePackage build of the open content project.

nodes.name: BeginNewProjectFlow
nodes.summary: Starts the new-project folder picker and name dialog.

nodes.name: SaveProject
nodes.summary: Writes project.json and the current scene so the content project stays in sync.

nodes.name: ConsumePendingFolderPick
nodes.summary: Applies a completed Win32 folder-picker result to open/create-project flows.

nodes.name: DrawEngineStartScreen
nodes.summary: Renders the no-project start screen with recent projects and new/open actions.

nodes.name: DrawEditorMenuBar
nodes.summary: Draws the File/Edit/Play menu bar that queues editor actions for the next frame.

nodes.name: ExecutePendingEditorAction
nodes.summary: Dispatches the queued menu action (save, play, build, project switch) after the ImGui frame.

nodes.name: DrawEditorPopups
nodes.summary: Draws modal dialogs for unsaved changes, new/open project, build preflight, and scene name prompts.

nodes.name: SaveSceneToFile
nodes.summary: Serializes the editor scene graph to a rom/scene JSON file.

nodes.name: NewScene
nodes.summary: Clears the current scene and starts an empty untitled scene.

nodes.name: TeardownPlaySession
nodes.summary: Stops play mode, restores editor runtime state, and optionally resets selection.

nodes.name: SoftStopPlayForSceneLoad
nodes.summary: Stops play without a full editor reset so a pending scene load can proceed.

nodes.name: ReturnToStart
nodes.summary: Leaves the editor session and returns to the project start screen.

nodes.name: HasThirdPersonPlayerNode
nodes.summary: Walks a subtree looking for a third-person player script/node.

nodes.name: HasCameraComponentNode
nodes.summary: Walks a subtree looking for a CameraComponent.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_IsDebugCameraPlayInputActive
nodes.summary: True when play mode is using the debug fly camera instead of a scene camera.

nodes.name: StartPlay
nodes.summary: Enters play mode: syncs SceneRuntime, starts scripts, and chooses debug vs scene camera.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_QueueSceneLoad
nodes.summary: Queues a scene filename to load after the current frame and any preload.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_BeginSceneAssetPreload
nodes.summary: Starts time-sliced model/animation warmup for the pending scene load.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_FlushSceneLoadPending
nodes.summary: Finishes preload and actually loads the queued scene into the editor graph.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_TickSceneAssetPreload
nodes.summary: Advances one preload step and returns whether warmup is still running.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_IsSceneAssetPreloadActive
nodes.summary: Returns whether a scene asset preload is currently in progress.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates ImGui, gizmos, asset indexes, and editor session state after D3D11 is ready.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_Finalize
nodes.summary: Shuts down ImGui, watchers, and editor subsystems on engine exit.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_IsPlaying
nodes.summary: Returns whether the editor is currently in play mode.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_PreferPlayVisuals
nodes.summary: True when draw paths should use play-mode (real) models instead of editor proxies.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_IsOnStart
nodes.summary: True while the start screen is showing and no project session is active.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_StartPlay
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that starts a play session from menus or shortcuts.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_StopPlay
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that stops play and restores the editor session.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_GetCameraMode
nodes.summary: Returns the current editor/play camera mode enum.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_SetCameraMode
nodes.summary: Sets the editor/play camera mode (scene camera vs debug camera).

nodes.name: EngineGUI_SetActiveCameraNodeName
nodes.summary: Pins play-mode rendering to a named CameraComponent node.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_SetEnabled
nodes.summary: Enables or disables the entire ImGui editor overlay.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_ResolveStartupScenePath
nodes.summary: Resolves the project default/last-opened scene path for editor boot.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_IsUiOverlayVisible
nodes.summary: Returns whether in-game UI overlay editing is visible.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_SetUiOverlayVisible
nodes.summary: Shows or hides the UI overlay editor layer.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_GetEditMode
nodes.summary: Returns the current editor edit mode (scene vs UI).

nodes.name: EngineGUI_SetEditMode
nodes.summary: Switches between scene-object editing and UI-canvas editing.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_IsUiEditMode
nodes.summary: True when the editor is editing UI canvas elements instead of 3D nodes.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_GetGameViewportRect
nodes.summary: Returns the game viewport rectangle inside the editor layout for picking and rendering.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_MouseToViewportLocal
nodes.summary: Converts a screen mouse position into viewport-local coordinates.

nodes.name: RaySphere
nodes.summary: Ray-sphere intersection used for light/camera gizmo picking.

nodes.name: RayIntersectsTriangle
nodes.summary: Möller–Trumbore ray-triangle test for mesh picking.

nodes.name: RayPickModelMesh
nodes.summary: Transforms a model's CPU vertices and finds the closest ray hit on its triangles.

nodes.name: BuildPickRay
nodes.summary: Builds a world-space pick ray from viewport mouse coordinates and the active camera.

nodes.name: DrawMeshWireframeHighlight
nodes.summary: Draws a wireframe overlay of a picked mesh via DebugDrawer.

nodes.name: DrawSelectionColliderHighlight
nodes.summary: Draws the selected node's collider volume in the viewport.

nodes.name: DrawSelectionHighlight
nodes.summary: Draws mesh/collider/light highlights for the current editor selection.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_DrawSelectionIndicator
nodes.summary: Public hook that draws the current selection highlight during the editor frame.

nodes.name: FocusSelectedObjectWithCamera
nodes.summary: Frames the editor camera on the selected object's world bounds.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_Update
nodes.summary: Per-frame editor update: shortcuts, gizmos, play/stop, preload, and pending actions.

nodes.name: DrawEditorSceneProxies
nodes.summary: Draws editor-only proxies (lights, cameras, colliders) when not in play visuals.

nodes.name: MoveNodeInList
nodes.summary: Reorders a node among its siblings by a signed offset.

nodes.name: GetNodeSiblingIndexLocal
nodes.summary: Returns a node's index in its parent's child list.

nodes.name: UndoableReorderNode
nodes.summary: Records an undoable hierarchy reorder for the selected node.

nodes.name: DrawSceneNodeHierarchy
nodes.summary: Recursively draws the scene-tree ImGui rows with drag-reorder and context actions.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_OnBackbufferResized
nodes.summary: Notifies the editor layout that the D3D backbuffer size changed.

nodes.name: EngineGUI_Draw
nodes.summary: Draws the entire editor UI for one frame: layout, hierarchy, inspector, viewport tools, and popups.

nodes.name: EditorLayoutMetrics
nodes.summary: Cached pixel metrics for the editor chrome: menu bar, toolbar, and pane rectangles used to lay out ImGui windows.

nodes.name: ClearFromOwner
nodes.summary: Removes any physics collider currently attached to the owning GameObject.

nodes.name: ApplyToOwner
nodes.summary: Builds a box/sphere/capsule/cylinder/mesh collider on the owner from serialized shape data and the cached model.

nodes.name: Serialize
nodes.summary: Writes collider type, size, trigger, and offset fields to JSON.

nodes.name: Deserialize
nodes.summary: Parses collider JSON and stores shape parameters for a later ApplyToOwner.

nodes.name: ToLowerString
nodes.summary: Lowercases a UTF-8 string with the classic locale for asset-key comparisons.

nodes.name: NormalizeAssetKey
nodes.summary: Normalizes slashes and case so model paths share one cache key.

nodes.name: StemKey
nodes.summary: Returns the lowercase filename stem used when looking up models by short name.

nodes.name: ResolveModelWidePath
nodes.summary: Resolves a model name or relative path to a wide filesystem path for LoadFBX.

nodes.name: SortFolderTree
nodes.summary: Recursively sorts model-folder nodes alphabetically for the editor browser.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Initializes the singleton cache and scans rom/model.

nodes.name: Finalize
nodes.summary: Releases cached Model3D instances and marks the cache finalized.

nodes.name: RefreshAssetDirectory
nodes.summary: Rescans rom/model and rebuilds ObjectDef entries for every FBX/OBJ.

nodes.name: RebuildFolderTree
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the hierarchical folder tree from indexed object definitions.

nodes.name: FolderPathForDef
nodes.summary: Returns the folder-relative path for one ObjectDef.

nodes.name: GetObjectDefinitionsInFolder
nodes.summary: Lists model definitions that live directly in a rom/model subfolder.
